# type-expression: type names in parameter, property and composite-literal positions.
# the syntax exemption reads a type name marked optional or implicitly unwrapped (`Name?`,
# `Name!`) as complete when the name reads as words, and a go slice, array or map type heads the
# composite literal or conversion after it.

# bracket capture, which does not reach the syntax step, so it is still reported.
# known gap: a generic argument naming a c type whose last snake_case word is a single letter,
# such as `UnsafeMutablePointer<surface_config_s>?`, does not read as words and still vetoes.
